hooks.name: Secret guard
hooks.description: Blocks writes containing key-shaped secrets (JWTs, Stripe/Resend keys, service role values). Part of security-hardening R7.1.

action.command: if grep -Eq 'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|sk_(live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}|re_[A-Za-z0-9]{24,}|SERVICE_ROLE_KEY[\"= :]+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{30,}|AC[a-f0-9]{32}'; then echo "Blocked by secret-guard: key-shaped string in write. Use an env var or Supabase secret instead (.kiro/steering/security.md)." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
